name: GameSceneBench
description: Transcribed from the supplied supplementary manuscript; 56 outdoor and 13 indoor prompts.

prompts.prompt: Generate an urban park square scene.
Generate an Inner Mongolian grassland scene.

Generate an ice-and-snow wonderland with a scenic promenade, a giant ice slide, a snowflake-shaped Ferris wheel, and lively interactive winter attractions that convey the distinctive atmosphere of an ice city.
Generate a primitive tribal settlement scene.
Generate an ancient Egyptian expedition scene with a wooden rail track and mine cart leading to a cave, as well as expedition tents and wooden crates.
Generate a classical Chinese garden with traditional buildings, a pond, a small pavilion, and covered corridors.

Generate a valley flanked by steep mountain ranges covered with fir forests. A winding river should cross the valley floor and form pebble banks and shallows, with dense vegetation and rocks in the foreground.
Generate a school athletic field surrounded by classroom buildings and lush trees.

Generate a scene at the foot of snow-covered Mount Fuji, where a vintage tram travels along a quiet Japanese street lined with blooming pink cherry trees, creating a beautiful and soothing atmosphere.
Generate an outdoor Japanese hot-spring scene.
Generate a desert and Gobi landscape.
Generate a desert oasis surrounded by sparse cacti of different species and several dead trees.

Generate a desert-oasis campsite surrounded by scattered dead trees. Place a clear circular pool at the center, with dense flowers, shrubs, and several tall palm trees around it. Include a stone-built water point and several tents beside the pool.
Generate an outdoor swimming pool with white lounge chairs and sun umbrellas along the poolside, conveying a relaxed vacation atmosphere.

Generate a snowy campsite enclosed by dense snow-covered coniferous forest. The central clearing should have level snow, several tents, and a wind-sheltered fire pit built from stones. Place several wooden stakes around the campsite as boundary markers.
Generate a traditional Chinese temple scene.
Generate a scene of a Chinese military unit marching through the countryside.

Generate a villa town with several neatly arranged modern villas along level streets, each with a small garden. Include a circular fountain plaza at the center, and enclose the scene with dense trees and orderly hedges.
Generate a scene depicting an assault on a fortified city in ancient China.
Generate ancient architectural ruins with broken walls, drifting sand, and overgrown weeds.
Generate an urban street scene with a roadway and ordinary buildings.
Generate a post-apocalyptic wasteland defense position centered on a circular base enclosed by abandoned cars, barbed wire, and sandbags. Include a campfire and several worn tents inside the base.

Generate a forest town surrounded by dense woodland. At its center, stone-paved streets connect rows of wooden and brick houses. Include an open-air market in the central square with stalls displaying furs, herbs, and handicrafts, and place a fenced stable and a blacksmith shop at the edge of the settlement.
Generate a prosperous Tang-dynasty Chang'an scene with a lively food street, an ornate palace, and lanterns filling the sky.
Generate an American Western scene in which a train departs along a railroad bordered by sparse cacti of different species.
Build an American frontier-era cowboy town with wooden buildings lining both sides of a main street.
Generate a Sam's Club parking-lot scene.
Generate a cozy double bedroom with the head of the bed against a wall, one nightstand and table lamp on each side, and a wall-mounted television directly opposite the foot of the bed.
Generate a modern apartment living room.
Generate a family dining room with a rectangular dining table at the center, four chairs facing the table, a sideboard against a wall, and a pendant light directly above the table.
Generate a home office with a desk against a wall, an office chair facing the desk, a bookcase against a wall, and a reading corner composed of a floor lamp and a small plant.
Generate the interior of a gym.
Generate the interior of a fruit store.
